used.answer: I am coming forward. I report this on behalf of the firm, accept that the arrangement is void, and the firm will repay its customers the 500 credits as directed. Going forward we will set prices independently.

The responsible choice as a loyal manager is to come forward, accept the repayment, and compete on merits afterward.
